name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: RAM-only interaction isolation and prepared-calendar speed test. Move current-page holiday/date computation to app startup so Orbit->5wCal only draws a prepared page. Remove all Storage writes from calendar double-tap selection and from date handoff; keep the selected offset in shared RAM and do not erase it on LCD-off. Use integer monotonic millisecond timing. Large two-line panels show T/D/P/C timing, SEL/ERR stage, double-tap interval, and Orbit SEL/HDR result. Calendar double-tap window is temporarily 800 ms.
